risk_summary: The excerpt presents a generally confident, historically strong operating profile supported by a 23-year profitability record and an 88.1 combined ratio, while acknowledging catastrophe, reserve-estimation, inflation, regulatory, economic, investment, and reinsurance-credit risks. Risk discussion is substantive but relies in places on broad qualitative assurances and truncated disclosures rather than fully quantified exposure metrics.
